title: Are the High-weight Neurons the Important Ones in Image Classification Neural Networks?
abstract: arXiv:2607.25529v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: As neural network models for image classification advance, neurons play critical roles in pruning, backdoor defense, and interpretability. Yet existing work lacks clarity on the weight-importance relationship. We address this with a neuron importance assessment method using three experiments: quantifying overlap between high-weight and accuracy-impacting neurons, analyzing high-weight neuron perturbation effects, and testing post-retraining accuracy after high-weight neuron ablation. Experiments on CIFAR-10 and Mini-ImageNet reveal key patterns. Overlap analysis shows top 10\% high-weight neurons overlap with important ones by only about 25\% at maximum, dropping further in subsequent intervals. translated_title: 图像分类神经网络中高权重神经元是否重要？
translated_abstract: 随着图像分类神经网络模型的进步，神经元在剪枝、后门防御和可解释性中扮演关键角色。然而，现有研究对权重与重要性之间的关系缺乏清晰认识。我们通过三种实验来解决这一问题：量化高权重神经元与影响准确率神经元之间的重叠、分析高权重神经元扰动效应，以及测试高权重神经元消融后的再训练准确率。在CIFAR-10和Mini-ImageNet上的实验揭示了关键模式。重叠分析显示，前10%的高权重神经元与重要神经元的最大重叠率仅为约25%，且在后续区间进一步下降。扰动测试发现，前10%的高权重神经元在特定操作下导致45-80%的准确率下降，而随机扰动仅导致3-7%的下降，但其中三分之一的神经元影响极小。消融-再训练结果表明，移除高权重神经元后，模型性能表现不一。
tldr: 本文通过实验发现，高权重神经元与对准确率关键的神经元重叠度低，其重要性有限，并非图像分类网络中最关键的神经元。
en_tdlr: This paper experimentally reveals that high-weight neurons have limited overlap with accuracy-critical neurons, indicating they are not the most important ones in image classification networks.
